Avantika Debuts on Get Physical With 'Moody Koyal' EP

bio_draft: Avantika is an Indian-born DJ, producer and singer who plays house music with live vocals, drawing on classical Indian vocal training and rock. Her debut EP, Moody Koyal, came out on Berlin label Get Physical Music in June 2025. Press around the release called her the first Indian DJ to play EXIT Festival in Serbia.
notes: Moody Koyal EP tracks: 'Maro Dum' (club take on 'Dum Maro Dum') and 'Moody Koyal'; catalogue GPM860. Her SoundCloud bio (oEmbed) also names a later release 'MAERI' with Eli Fola (Indo-Afro rhythms, Punjabi vocals); a Beatport page (beatport.com/it/release/maeri/6878498) showed in search but failed to load, so it is not listed in releases. New Delhi as base city comes only from Viberate (a data aggregator); press says only 'Indian'. RA past events include Mirage Bangalore (May 2026), Sri Lanka (SOLA Festival Feb 2025, NYE 2025) and Nepal (Jun 2026). The bandcamp.com/avantikabakshi page is a fan collection, not an artist page.

bio_draft: Full Motion Disaster, also known as FMD, is a Mumbai-based DJ and producer. He owns and runs Filth Inc., a Mumbai record label and promotional channel started in March 2019 that began with lo-fi house and moved into ghettotech, electro, breakbeat and rave. His sets mix electro, ghettotech, ghetto house, breakbeat and rave, usually rising from about 130 to 160 bpm.
notes: Era source is his own SoundCloud bio (read via oEmbed; no press found). Era start year 2023 is his earliest release found on Filth Inc. Bandcamp; the label itself dates from March 2019. His bio says his mixes appeared on Moskalus, welofi, 4NCY, Nu Kvlture, Limited Liability, Q-Radio, Ocean Drive Radio and Bass Water Freak Out; none were opened, so mix_links is empty. He owns the label, so filth-inc.bandcamp.com is a label page, not an artist id. A second SoundCloud account soundcloud.com/fullmotiondisaster also exists (no bio); unclear if his. Bandcamp tags on his tracks also include trance, eurodance and bounce. Rolling Stone India (3 Sep 2021, Bandcamp Friday) mentions Filth Inc. but not him. His legal name is on SoundCloud; left out of aliases and bio.
